comparison.objective: Swap two failed fans in a running fan wall, one bay at a time; candidate breaks and recovers four HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Title indicates sequential fan-module replacement; candidate requires coaxial mandrel alignment, separately manipulated hammering, and tiny-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: The body and rubric are absent, so fan-specific thresholds and safeguards are unknown; the stated outcome is two one-at-a-time fan swaps, unlike four notch fractures with retained inserts and contained fragments.
comparison.reason: Available evidence still establishes a module-replacement objective rather than impact-driven insert finishing; missing numeric details do not create a plausible duplicate.
